name: pf-fix-pyrebrand-charge
about: fix-pyrebrand-charge against the built packages classes, specs instead of the mods' source folders (tools/make_package_scenarios.py). Issue #35, Pyrebrand's payoff too small: the brand now charges as it burns. A rank 5 Branding warlock brands a 15000 HP QA dummy and feeds it two rank 5 Demon's Tails; left to run out, the Hellfire Claw is pb-base 40 + 500% of the stored damage at charge 1.0000 and takes at least five times the Tails' HP from the dummy (fire pool included). A second brand recast at ~3 s claws at its charge then (0.3-0.7) for less. Noncrit control; the claw log line `claw (<why>) N fire, charge C of S stored`.
